interpretation: R and J validation-best beat B0 on all five test metrics by descriptive scene-bootstrap intervals. L best improves all depth-error/accuracy metrics and boundary-band error but its mean boundary F1 is lower than B0. This F1 direction is mixed by seed:112and114 worse,113better.

L best versus R best improves AbsRel/RMSE/delta1/boundary-band error but loses mean F1, again mixed across seeds. J best versus R best improves RMSE/F1/band while AbsRel anddelta1 intervals cross zero.

J best versus L best has worse AbsRel in all3seeds, higher mean F1 (seed signs+,-,+), and worse mean boundary-band error (two seeds improve, third worsens more). RMSE/delta1 intervals cross zero. Do not infer a universal joint-training edge benefit from the mean F1 contrast.

All3Lseeds lose F1 after best; mean0.444397932 to0.389534224. Seed114 is strongest:0.406724638 to0.290047443,584images worse13better57tie,zero-edge images53to121,predictededges1018761to702836. Firstseed also declines0.039877093; this is not solely one failing seed.

All3Jseeds also lose F1 after best, but less:mean0.475236750 to0.463014021. Final delta1 declines and banderror improves on average; AbsRel/RMSE endpoint intervals cross zero. J final versusB0 F1 interval crosseszero despite all3mean seed differencespositive.

All3Rseeds meet the frozen validation terminal-stability diagnostic, no L orJseed does. R best-to-final AbsRel/F1/delta1/band differences are small or inconclusive by intervals; RMSE increases. Stable membership is validation-only and is not adjusted by test.

For200to300 best: R improves AbsRel and banderror but loses F1; RMSE/delta1 inconclusive. L improves banderror but loses F1; overall3inconclusive. J improves F1 but worsens banderror; overall3inconclusive, with meanAbsRel actually higher. More fitting samples do not improve every measure monotonically.

For300to400 best: R improves AbsRel/delta1; other3intervalscrosszero. L improvesdelta1/F1 but worsensbanderror in all3seeds; AbsRel/RMSEinconclusive. J improvesAbsRel/banderror but losesF1 in all3seeds; RMSE/delta1inconclusive.

For300to400 final: J mean deteriorates on all5metrics, largely driven by knownJ400114 endpoint failure. PerseedAbsRel/RMSE/band improve for112and113 but worsen sharply for114. This must not be presented as all seeds degrading with more data.

The actual L300114 fixed-image review supports the numerical accuracy/edge separation: image1449 has lower AbsRel but fewer matched chair-back edges at final; image0001 edgeF1alreadyzeroatbest; image0770 is worse thanB0 in both endpoints. Only those3images visually reviewed for this seed.

All interval claims are descriptive, conditional on the three trained seeds, with no multiple-comparison correction. This is a previously viewed official test; no checkpoint or hyperparameter is changed in response.
